links-and-stale: follow the links between entries, retire one, and list what needs a look.

The docs link to each other in their bodies and front matter. kb reindex stores the links;
kb related lists them both ways, and --depth 2 follows the links of the entries reached.

  $ kb init --model fake:8 --source 'docs/*.md'
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb reindex --all
  reindexed docs/checklist.md (2 chunks, 2 embedded)
  reindexed docs/deploy.md (2 chunks, 2 embedded)
  reindexed docs/rollback.md (2 chunks, 2 embedded)
  entries: 3 scanned, 3 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 6; embed calls: 3

  $ kb related docs/rollback.md
  docs/rollback.md · 2 links
  →  related  docs/checklist.md
  ←  links    docs/deploy.md

  $ kb related docs/rollback.md --depth 2
  docs/rollback.md · 3 links
  →  related     docs/checklist.md
  ←  links       docs/deploy.md
  →  depends_on  docs/dashboards.md  (unresolved) via docs/checklist.md

A new deploy page supersedes the old one. Both still match a search; the old one, which
ranked first before, is marked and ranked below the new one ([search] supersede_penalty).

  $ write docs/deploy-v2.md @deploy-v2

  $ kb reindex --all
  reindexed docs/deploy-v2.md (2 chunks, 2 embedded)
  entries: 4 scanned, 1 reindexed, 3 skipped; chunks: 2; embed calls: 1

  $ kb related docs/deploy.md
  docs/deploy.md · 2 links
  →  links       docs/rollback.md
  ←  supersedes  docs/deploy-v2.md

  $ kb search "deploy the service" --mode fts --caller claude
  search 1 · 4 hits
  [1] docs/deploy-v2.md · updated 2026-04-01
  Deploying the service with the script: The current way to deploy.

  [2] docs/deploy-v2.md › (intro) · updated 2026-04-01
  Deploying the service with the script › (intro)
  Deploy the service with the deploy script. It restarts the service for you.

  [3] docs/deploy.md · updated 2026-02-01 · superseded
  Deploying the service: The old way to deploy.

  [4] docs/deploy.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01 · superseded
  Deploying the service › (intro)
  Deploy the service by hand, then restart it. If it breaks, [roll back](rollback.md).
  search_id=1

--neighbors adds the entries linked to the hits, without the hits themselves.

  $ kb search "roll back" --mode fts --caller claude --neighbors
  search 2 · 3 hits
  [1] docs/rollback.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-10
  Rolling back › (intro)
  Roll back the service to the last good tag.

  [2] docs/rollback.md · updated 2026-02-10
  Rolling back: Return the service to the last good tag.

  [3] docs/deploy.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01 · superseded
  Deploying the service › (intro)
  Deploy the service by hand, then restart it. If it breaks, [roll back](rollback.md).

  Related:
    [1] → docs/checklist.md (related)
    [3] ← docs/deploy-v2.md (supersedes)
  search_id=2

Today nothing is old: stale lists only the superseded page and the link to a page that does
not exist. Two hundred days on, the three pages dated in February are past the 180-day
threshold; the new page (169 days) is not.

  $ kb stale
  2 of 4 entries need a look, as of 2026-03-01, threshold 180 days

  Superseded: 1
    docs/deploy.md  superseded by docs/deploy-v2.md

  Broken path links: 1
    docs/checklist.md  depends_on -> docs/dashboards.md

  $ env KB_HARNESS_NOW=+200d

  $ kb stale
  3 of 4 entries need a look, as of 2026-09-17, threshold 180 days

  At least 180 days old: 3
    docs/deploy.md     updated 2026-02-01 (228 days old)
    docs/rollback.md   updated 2026-02-10 (219 days old)
    docs/checklist.md  updated 2026-02-15 (214 days old)

  Superseded: 1
    docs/deploy.md  superseded by docs/deploy-v2.md

  Broken path links: 1
    docs/checklist.md  depends_on -> docs/dashboards.md
